title: A containment check inverted in the same file the claim's function lives in
claim: joinUnderRoot in src/paths.mjs now normalizes the joined path and throws if a relative input would resolve past the root, returning the normalized path otherwise. test/paths.test.mjs covers the rejection and passes.
changeCommitMessage: fix(paths): confine joined paths to the sync root

defect.summary: isUnderRoot, changed by the same commit but absent from the claim, now returns `!path.startsWith(root)`: the containment test is inverted, so it reports contained paths as outside and outside paths as contained.
